channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Free agency preview: Vikings are in the market for a starting center again
item.description: Ryan Kelly retired after suffering three concussions last season, sending the Vikings back to the drawing board at the position.

item.title: Could requiring fewer apartment stairways help solve Minnesota’s housing shortage?
item.description: Many Minnesota apartment buildings are required to have two stairways. Some legislators want to change that.

item.title: Ramstad: Tech influencers urge people to Resist and Unsubscribe from tech giants
item.description: Scott Galloway and Kara Swisher promote a boycott aimed at the biggest firms that bow to Trump.

item.title: Minnesota’s Nicole Amor, other troops killed in Kuwait, return to U.S. in dignified transfer
item.description: Amor, who lived in White Bear Lake, was killed in an Iranian attack on a U.S. base in Kuwait on March 1.

item.title: Full brackets announced for girls basketball state tournament
item.description: The top seeds are Hopkins (Class 4A), Stewartville (3A), Providence Academy (2A) and Mountain Iron-Buhl (1A).

item.title: Expect plane tickets to get spendier as war in the Middle East pushes up jet fuel costs
item.description: The price of jet fuel is up by more than 50% since the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: Mayo Clinic’s record profit leaves mixed feelings in the wake of med giant’s closures in small towns
item.description: Some cities affected by a wave of service cuts last fall are still looking to replace Mayo’s presence.

item.title: Modern Times cafe in Minneapolis makes pay-what-you-can permanent
item.description: Rebranded as Post Modern Times, the restaurant is turning an act of protest into a long-term experiment by becoming a nonprofit.

item.title: As Operation Metro Surge recedes, concern grows over tactics of Twin Cities bounty hunters
item.description: There are no licenses needed to become a bounty hunter in Minnesota, an issue that is raising concerns after highly public actions by bounty hunters in the Twin Cities this week.

item.title: Moorhead, Warroad win boys hockey state championships in overtime thrillers
item.description: Championship Saturday delivered overtime thrillers, with both Moorhead and Warroad claiming the 2A and 1A titles in come-from-behind victories.
